methods.label: Compare census feasibility
methods.explanation: A census is suitable when there are very few subjects and measurements are easy to take. Testing the lifespan of light bulbs is destructive, while nationwide audiences and the water quality of the Yangtze River cover large scopes, so sampling is appropriate for these.
methods.levelReason: The argument uses the Grade 7 criteria of population size, measurement feasibility, and destructive testing.
